sections.Profile:
Stampede into the Yukon in search of fortune, battle rapids and avalanches, outwit Soapy Smith, survive the climb to Chilkoot Pass, and raid Yukon Yeti's hidden stash in a wild pinball adventure inspired by the Klondike Gold Rush.
